recognize_zh: 低倍免疫染色顯示真皮淺中層多處血管周圍陽性淋巴球團，並有陽性細胞沿表皮基底層分布，呈 T 細胞表皮向性浸潤的分布型態，符合 ATLL 皮膚侵犯。
features: Multiple discrete superficial and mid-dermal perivascular clusters of immunoreactive lymphoid cells
Scattered positive cells along the dermoepidermal junction and within the basal epidermis
Deeper dermis contains only sparse single positive cells
Low magnification precludes assessment of cytology
describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain of skin (specific marker not labeled) highlights multiple perivascular lymphoid aggregates in the superficial and mid dermis, with scattered positive cells at the dermoepidermal junction and within the basal epidermis. The deep dermis contains only sparse positive cells, and the epidermis is otherwise negative. The distribution indicates a perivascular and epidermotropic T-cell infiltrate, consistent with cutaneous involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma in the appropriate clinical and serologic context.

ddx.vs: The epidermotropic perivascular pattern overlaps; HTLV-1 serology and diffuse CD25 expression favor ATLL.
T-PLL tends to form perivascular/periadnexal dermal infiltrates with less epidermotropism and is TCL1-positive.
Reactive T cells are small, polyclonal, and not accompanied by aberrant antigen loss or HTLV-1 infection.
